terms: Founding-hotel pilot for the first 10 independent hotels in Tbilisi.
0% Stumari fee on every booking until 31 December 2026. After that, a flat 1.5% of what the hotel receives, written into each booking on-chain before the guest pays.
Paid in USDC on Solana to a wallet you control, automatically 24 hours after the guest checks in — unless the guest opens a dispute in that window, which Stumari's arbiter decides.
Guest refunds follow the contract the guest chose, automatically.
Guests need only USDC — no SOL, no network fees. Guests holding USDT swap to USDC inside Phantom.
Free 20-minute setup call: we connect your Booking.com/Airbnb calendars (iCal) where available and set your room rates and the contracts you want to offer.
You keep all your existing channels. Stumari adds a direct booking link for guests who pay in stablecoins, and a channel AI agents can book through. We don't bring you guests.
You choose which contracts to offer and your price bounds; the model prices each request to target your current expected revenue.
Per-booking limit of 1,500 USDC during the pilot.
No exclusivity, no minimums, leave anytime.
We help you set up a wallet and point you to licensed providers for converting USDC to lari. We don't give legal, tax or financial advice.

items.a: Payouts arrive as USDC in a wallet you control. To convert USDC to lari, use a licensed provider. We'll point you to options on the setup call. We don't convert funds for you, and this is not financial advice.

items.q: Is it legal for my hotel to accept USDC?
items.a: Ask your accountant. How you accept and declare stablecoin income depends on how your business is registered. We don't give legal, tax or financial advice.

items.q: What if the room is booked on Booking.com at the same moment?
items.a: Every Stumari booking starts as pending. We re-check your calendars before confirming it. If it can't be confirmed within 2 hours, the guest gets a full refund. Confirmed bookings appear in the calendar feed you paste into Booking.com and Airbnb, so the dates close there too.

items.q: What happens if a guest disputes?
items.a: A guest can open a dispute only in the 24 hours after check-in. The payout then waits for Stumari's arbiter, who can split the escrow between the guest and you. During the pilot the arbiter is a single Stumari key. Outside that window the program's rules let nobody redirect the money. During the pilot Stumari can still upgrade the program itself: see “What we don't claim”.
Only USDC on Solana in a wallet such as Phantom. No SOL and no network fees: Stumari pays them. Guests holding USDT swap to USDC inside Phantom first.

items.q: I sell several identical rooms as one room type. Does the calendar sync work?
items.a: Booking.com and Airbnb usually export one iCal calendar per listing, so identical rooms sold as one room type may share a single calendar. We check your extranet together on the setup call before connecting anything. Rooms that are their own listing connect in minutes.
No. We're not an OTA and you keep all your channels. Stumari adds a booking link for guests who pay in stablecoins, and a channel AI agents can book through.
